hooks.name: Review Dart write against project standards
hooks.description: Before any file write, verify the change follows project steering standards: no inline hex colors, no inline TextStyle, no hard-coded secrets, AI calls only in service layer (never directly from screens/widgets), and abstract service pattern is preserved.

action.prompt:
Before completing this file write, verify it follows our project-standards steering rules:
1. No inline hex color values — use AppColors.*
2. No inline TextStyle(fontSize:...) — use AppTextStyles.*
3. No secrets, API keys, or ARNs in source code
4. AI / Bedrock calls must only appear in lib/core/services/ — never in screens or widgets
5. Abstract service interface pattern is preserved (abstract class + implementation)
6. All screens use AppColors.background as scaffold background color
If any rule is violated, flag it clearly before the write proceeds.
